verdict.rationale: The speech-to-text convert API documents a webhook mode: the request is processed asynchronously and results are pushed to configured webhooks, so callers do not need to poll for completed transcripts. The evidence is a single parameter description and never says whether a callback fires on job failure. missing for 10: documented failure/error callbacks, webhook registration and configuration details, payload schema, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a webhook or callback fires when a job completes or fails, so nothing in my system has to poll

citations.quote: If webhook is set to true, the request will be processed asynchronously and results sent to configured webhooks.
